blocks.text: Chuugoku Musume (中國娘) is a common character trope of Chinese charaters in Japanese anime, manga, and video games inspired by Japanese perceptions of Chinese culture. In Chinese the character trope is known as Zhonghua niang (中华娘) and has developed into a niche fashion on social media such as Rednote.
Under Construction Typically portrayed as either genki (energetic, cheerful) like Ranma ½'s Shampoo, or mysterious and elegant like Code Geass's Wang Liu Mei.
Predominantly vibrant red, gold, green and black, along with other colors associated with Chinese culture in Japanese media
Steamers of dim sum and bowls of noodles
Dango atama (お団子頭): two round buns on either side of the head, often wrapped with cloth and tied with ribbons
Chaina-fuku (チャイナ服): form-fitting dress inspired by the qipao and other Chinese clothing, frequently modified for anime aesthetics with shorter hemlines, etc.
